text.en:
Section 40(b) of Presidential Decree No. 1618 is hereby amended to read as follows:
"(b) The Office of the Regional Commissioner in each of the Autonomous Regions is hereby abolished and its
appropriations, properties, and assets and liabilities and such personnel as may be necessary, shall be
transferred immediately to the Sangguniang Pampook which shall in turn transfer the same to the Lupong
Tagapagpaganap Ng Pook immediately upon the organization of the latter."

This Decree shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, Philippines, this 20th day of September, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred
and seventy-nine.
